# GTRigidPhysics

> A vanilla-compatible rigid body physics engine for Minecraft Paper 26.2 — structural collapse, vehicles, dice and props. Server-side only, no client mod.

Every page below is available as Markdown: take the page URL, drop the
trailing slash and append `.md`. A zip of all pages is at
`/export/gtrigidphysics-docs-en.zip`; the full text of the whole site,
concatenated, is at `llms-full.txt` next to this file.
